notes.replay: Source BTC archive dates and timeframe, with ETH using the same UTC dates. Both cases independently verify decision flags, next-open rows, closed lots and every native marked equity snapshot.
notes.costs: Source omits commissions. Report overlays 0.075% per side on closed lots. No independent spread, slippage or funding data is claimed and reported drawdown uses realized P&L.
notes.positions: The native default starts each separate market at 1M USDT and retains authored base-unit sizing. No order on the terminal date is filled outside the documented period.
notes.scope: Historical compatibility execution using documented source defaults. The deleted higher-timeframe graph has no consumers outside itself.
notes.pivot_precision: The source treats the numeric deviation as a boolean. The pinned engine uses an incremental rolling sum and exact zero. Mathematically flat windows can fail this gate under floating-point rounding. The separate sensitivity records all changed command flags under a stable exact-price flatness check.

Original BTC daily window plus matched ETH. Independently reconciled all 28 order flags on each bar, 17 market fills, 10 closed FIFO lots and EMA-initialization control. Results use the pinned runtime floating-point deviation gate.
